description: This file defines the PrismaBookingAuditRepository class implementing IBookingAuditRepository for managing booking audit logs using Prisma ORM. It includes methods for creating logs, batch creation, and fetching logs related to specific bookings, with schema validation and safe data selection.

classes.name: PrismaBookingAuditRepository
classes.description: Repository class for booking audit logs, implementing create, batch create, and retrieval methods with Prisma ORM.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new booking audit log entry in the database.

methods.name: createMany
methods.description: Creates multiple booking audit logs in a batch operation.

methods.name: findAllForBooking
methods.description: Retrieves all audit logs for a specific booking, including actor details.

methods.name: findRescheduledLogsOfBooking
methods.description: Retrieves all 'RESCHEDULED' audit logs for a specific booking, including actor details.
